courses.title: Zen e Danza – workshop con Annamaria Gyoetsu Epifanìa
courses.description: Workshops led by Annamaria Gyoetsu Epifanìa, dancer and Zen nun at the centre, that bring Zen practice into movement: everyday gesture, breath and nature become ways of dancing with full presence. She draws on the teaching of Dainin Katagiri and her teacher Shohaku Okumura.

courses.title: Ascolto Consapevole – percorsi individuali
courses.description: One-to-one 'mindful listening' sessions with Annamaria Gyoetsu Epifanìa, described as a path of self-knowledge: close, non-judging attention to everyday gesture, sensation and what one's experience needs to say. The first meeting is an orientation session by appointment.

left_out: Tai Chi – Qi Gong: the page says doctors recognise tai chi's 'curative' properties, that it prevents degenerative diseases and osteoporosis and strengthens the immune system: disease and immunity claims, still out.

Danza Creativa – Danzaterapia: lists 'prevenzione e cura di eventuali disturbi posturali' (prevention and treatment of postural disorders) among its aims, a treatment claim, so left out under the new rule (otherwise a creative dance class with relaxation and improvisation).
flags: Zen e Danza: the page describes the workshops but gives no dates or price, so it goes in undated with 'Contact for pricing'.

Ascolto Consapevole: individual sessions opening 'a contact with what in us suffers'; framed as a Zen-rooted method of self-knowledge rather than therapy, with no health claim (an opening Hippocrates quote speaks of inner strength as the source of health). A human may want to check it sits on the right side of the therapy scope rule. No price; first meeting by phone appointment.
Both are taught by Annamaria Gyoetsu Epifanìa, who co-leads the centre with Guglielmo Doryu Cappelli (as the original plan's bio says).
With these two the listing has 5 offerings in the original plan's count.
